holding_company.name: Emergence Software
holding_company.ceo_background: Formerly Blackstone, TA Associates, Thrive Capital
holding_company.geographic_preference: US-primary; expanding internationally (UAE, ANZ, LATAM targets)
holding_company.strategy: Acquire profitable, niche B2B software businesses with durable customer bases; layer modern AI infrastructure; build cross-portfolio playbooks; no forced exit timeline

portfolio_companies.name: AutoHub
portfolio_companies.vertical: Vehicle trade-in appraisal & dealer lead generation
portfolio_companies.product_usp: In-store and digital vehicle appraisal app for dealerships. Generates first-party trade-in leads from dealer websites; standardised appraisal workflow covering cosmetic and mechanical condition; customer print-outs; integrates with dealer DMS systems.
portfolio_companies.post_acquisition_plan: First anchor of Emergence's automotive vertical roll-up; foundation layer for multi-product automotive data ecosystem
portfolio_companies.notes: Bootstrapped to $9.6M ARR with a tiny team — extremely capital efficient. Emergence's first automotive bet, indicating they identified the vertical thesis early.

portfolio_companies.name: NYVUS
portfolio_companies.product_usp: Digital strategic information platform for automotive dealerships. Automates competitive analysis using customisable valuation tables; tracks monthly and cumulative evolution of list and discounted vehicle prices weighted by monthly sales volume; helps sales teams benchmark their pricing against direct competitors.
portfolio_companies.customers: Auto dealerships (US, Miami-centric, likely LATAM-facing given Miami HQ)
portfolio_companies.post_acquisition_plan: Pricing intelligence layer that complements AutoHub's appraisal tooling; feeds into the broader automotive data stack
portfolio_companies.notes: Founded in 1996 — a 29-year-old business. Classic Emergence target: durable, deeply embedded niche software with decades of customer relationships. Revenue and employee count not public.

portfolio_companies.name: MedEvolve
portfolio_companies.vertical: AI-powered RCM workflow automation and analytics
portfolio_companies.total_funding_pre_acquisition: Series A (2002, Diamond State Ventures) — amount undisclosed; effectively bootstrapped for 20+ years after
portfolio_companies.revenue: $10M+ ARR (crossed $10M milestone noted on company history page; 2024 estimates suggest $15-25M range)
portfolio_companies.product_usp: Effective Intelligence® platform — captures millions of workflow actions across the healthcare revenue cycle to create a proprietary benchmarking dataset. Uniquely ties employee work effort to financial performance in real time. Combines: (1) Patient Financial Clearance Automation, (2) Medical Billing Workflow Automation, (3) Real-Time RCM Analytics. Gives healthcare execs granular visibility into workforce performance, process breakdowns, and technology gaps.
portfolio_companies.customers: US healthcare providers — physician groups, health systems, RCM services companies. New clients include RCM360, Pettigrew Healthcare, Future Care Consultants, HCPM, Quantix Corp. Strategic partnership with Veradigm.
portfolio_companies.awards: Rated #1 RCM Workflow Optimization Solution, Black Book RCM Client Survey 2023 and 2024
portfolio_companies.post_acquisition_plan: Expand data science, automation, and AI-driven analytics; accelerate next-gen AI capabilities; expand to more healthcare providers nationwide. Divested RCM services business to Sustainable Medical Billing (post-acquisition) to focus on software.
portfolio_companies.hipaa_note: Settled HIPAA investigation with HHS for $350K in 2023 — historical compliance risk worth noting.
portfolio_companies.notes: The most substantial portfolio company by employee count and likely revenue. The only non-automotive holding, signalling Emergence is building two distinct verticals: automotive data and healthcare tech.

portfolio_companies.name: Pureinfluencer
portfolio_companies.vertical: Dealer website conversion & first-party lead generation
portfolio_companies.product_usp: ML-powered conversion platform for automotive and RV dealerships and marketing agencies. Guaranteed 30%+ lift in first-party website leads; 15-20% higher lead closing rate vs. baseline. Segments genuine human traffic from bot traffic; behavioural engagement tools to convert website visitors; optimises marketing spend and reduces wasted ad spend. Tracks visitor behaviour and triggers real-time conversion nudges.
portfolio_companies.customers: Franchise auto dealerships, RV dealers, automotive marketing agencies. Claims thousands of dealer customers. Also expanding to solar installation sector.
portfolio_companies.post_acquisition_plan: Positioned as the digital marketing / lead generation layer within Emergence's automotive data stack; European expansion (UK, Germany) was in roadmap pre-acquisition
portfolio_companies.notes: Tiny team, meaningful revenue — another extremely capital-efficient operator. Complements AutoHub (trade-in) and NYVUS (pricing intelligence) as the top-of-funnel/website conversion layer.

portfolio_companies.name: AlgoDriven
portfolio_companies.vertical: AI-powered used car valuation, appraisal, and inventory management
portfolio_companies.revenue: 5x growth since 2021 Series A; profitable at time of acquisition; estimated $5-15M range
portfolio_companies.acquisition_deal_size: $10M-$50M all-cash (confirmed by CEO Glenn Harwood to Australian Financial Review)
portfolio_companies.product_usp: EvalExpert — AI-powered used vehicle appraisal app. Dealers scan vehicle registration, take photos, input condition data; proprietary AI generates real-time valuation, market-driven pricing recommendation, and AI-guided repair cost estimates. One in every three used cars sold in Australia is analysed by AlgoDriven's technology. Market leader in both MENA region and Australia/New Zealand.
portfolio_companies.customers: Car dealerships, banks, insurance companies, fleet operators across 14+ countries. #1 automotive software appraisal provider in MENA and ANZ.
portfolio_companies.post_acquisition_plan: US and Latin American expansion; deeper AI capability development; brand retained post-acquisition; both co-founders committed to 5-year tenure
portfolio_companies.notes: Most international portfolio company. The $10-50M exit on $2.73M raised is a strong outcome for investors. Gives Emergence a meaningful international footprint and opens MENA/ANZ market access. Both founders staying is a strong signal of cultural alignment.

portfolio_companies.name: GemTalk Systems
portfolio_companies.founder: Dan Ware (management buyout from VMware, 2013) — transitioning to CRO post-acquisition
portfolio_companies.revenue: ~$785K (LeadIQ Jul 2025 estimate — likely understated; support contracts for enterprise software typically higher)
portfolio_companies.product_usp: GemStone/S — a high-performance, object-oriented transactional database with 44 years of heritage. Uniquely combines an object database with a Smalltalk execution engine, enabling 24x7 high-volume transaction processing without the impedance mismatch of ORM layers. Trusted by Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), JPMorgan Chase, UBS for financial trading infrastructure. Also used in government (border security, visa processing), utilities (customer billing since 1992), and telecom (cable management since 1993).
portfolio_companies.customers: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), JPMorgan Chase, UBS, Momentum Metropolitan Holdings, government agencies; 100+ enterprise customers across finance, healthcare, telecom, utilities, government
portfolio_companies.post_acquisition_plan: Increase product development investment; expand engineering team; maintain support and stability for existing customers; explore how GemStone/S fits evolving enterprise workloads (AI-era data infrastructure)
portfolio_companies.history: Founded 1982 as Servio Logic → renamed GemStone Systems 1995 → acquired by Brokat 2000 → MBO 2001 → acquired by VMware/SpringSource 2010 → MBO by Dan Ware to form GemTalk Systems 2013
portfolio_companies.notes: The most strategically distinctive acquisition. Not automotive, not healthcare — a 44-year-old enterprise database that underpins some of the world's most critical financial infrastructure. Tiny team, extremely sticky customer base. Classic 'orphaned gem' — big tech company (VMware) sold it; no one invested; customers kept running it for decades anyway. Highest strategic AI potential: GemStone/S's object model is a natural fit for graph-style AI data workloads.

portfolio_summary.combined_estimated_revenue: $35-60M ARR across portfolio (rough estimate; MedEvolve and AutoHub anchor this)
